WITH state_totals AS (
  SELECT c.state_county_province, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) as state_total
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE ft.transaction_amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(state_total) as total FROM state_totals
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.state_county_province,
    st.state_total,
    CAST(st.state_total AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM grand_total) as share
  FROM state_totals st
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
),
above_average_states AS (
  SELECT ws.state_total, ws.share
  FROM with_shares ws
  WHERE ws.share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(aas.state_total) as combined_total,
  AVG(aas.share) as average_share_of_above_avg_states,
  AVG(aas.share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share) as avg_excess
FROM above_average_states aas
